config_fields.name: company_subdomain
config_fields.help: The company's Pinpoint careers-site subdomain, e.g. 'workwithus' in https://workwithus.pinpointhq.com.

search.note: Public Job Postings JSON Endpoint for ONE company's careers site (config company_subdomain): GET https://{company-subdomain}.pinpointhq.com/postings.json, which 'returns all job posting[s] for each job as they appear on your career site' (no auth). location is sent as location_city_state_name ('filter by city/state name of the location', comma-separated values OR'ed, e.g. 'San Francisco, CA' or 'London'). There is no keyword or paging parameter, so query/page/limit are not sent: every posting comes back in one response — filter client-side and do not request further pages. Compensation fields are null unless compensation_visible; compensation_frequency, employment_type, workplace_type, deadline_at, department/division, job{} and the benefits/responsibilities/skills HTML sections are in raw. Pinpoint also hosts an MCP server for its authenticated ATS API (https://developers.pinpointhq.com/docs/mcp).

not_offered.me: The postings feed is public and keyless; there is no account endpoint to verify.
not_offered.get_posting: The postings feed has no per-posting endpoint; re-read the record (id) from the search hit or open its url.
not_offered.apply: Applications are made on the Pinpoint careers page (url); the authenticated API is the employer's (API key from the Pinpoint account), not a candidate apply endpoint.
not_offered.list_messages: No candidate messaging in the public feed.
